messages:
Alejandra: Hey team — quick kickoff: Culture Month idea = 'Thank You PenPals' ✉️. We want every Redwooder to be able to send one short handwritten postcard to someone in a different team/region. Low effort, high delight. Volunteers to help with printing, address collection, and shipping?

Samir: love this. do we have a budget? rough estimate for 500 postcards + intl shipping? :thinking_face:  

Mina: I can do vendor ops. suggest local print houses in US/EU/APAC to avoid crazy international postage. also we can offer digital e-card fallback for remote regions.  

Dylan: Volunteer for assembling + packing. can help coordinate with Office Admin for studio space. :raised_hands:  

Alejandra: Budget estimate: $750 for printing + $400 shipping buffer (ballpark). If we get 1:1 matching from microgrant fund we can cover it. @Tara can you confirm budget availability? 

Tara: Allocated $1k from culture fund for Q2 initiatives — we can earmark $900. OK from my side if we keep it under that. please file expense request with code CULT-002.

Mina: For addresses: we should avoid collecting personal home addresses. Proposed opt-in flow: people can choose "Ship to office" (then we coordinate desk drop) or "Send e-card" or "Provide work-adjacent PO Box". Need copy for the signup form.

Alejandra: Good call. I'll write the short form copy. Signup li nk (draft): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBcD-PENPAL-SIGNUP (please don't edit until I share). Volunteers can RSVP there.

Samir: Can we include a small prompt pack (one-sentence prompts) so people don't overthink the note? e.g., 'a quick win you appreciated', 'a shoutout for steady support', 'a fun memory'.

Alejandra: Yes, I'll draft prompt cards and a postcard front design. Draft template for the back of the postcard (handwritten area):

```
Dear <Name>,

Thank you for <specific thing — 1 sentence>.

— <Your name>, <Team>
```

Mina: For printing specs: 4x6 postcard, 300gsm matte stock, bleed .125in, print-ready PNG or PDF. I can share preferred local vendors per region.

Dylan: Logistics note — for remote employees in countries with strict customs, we should use e-card only unless they opt-in to provide a safe shipping address.

Logistics (Ops): We can handle bulk shipping to office hubs for desk drops. Need final counts by May 5 to hit the May 20 ship date. Lead times: US 3 business days, EU 5, APAC 7 (printing + pack).

Alejandra: Timeline: signups open today through May 2. Volunteer pack filling May 6–10. Print approvals May 11. Ship week of May 20.

Tara: I'll create the expense request and approve once I see final vendor quote. Also looping in legal about any PII concerns for address collection.

Samir: Can we add a small sticker or Redwood pin to each card? cost per unit? :pin:  

Mina: Stickers ok, pins probably over budget. Stickers ~$0.15 ea in bulk. add to budget if folks want.

Alejandra: Action items: (1) Mina -> vendor list + cost estimates by EOD Tue (2) Dylan -> volunteer pack + station signups (3) Tara -> expense code + legal ping (4) Alejandra -> signup form + postcard mockups.

People Ops Bot: Reminder set — will ping the #people-ops channel May 1 for final 48-hour signup reminder.

Dylan: thumbs up. I'll open a rota in the sheet for assembly shifts.

Alejandra: Thank you all! excited to try a low-friction way to spread gratitude. :heart: If anyone else wants to help with copy or translations (ES/FR/JP), please DM me.

Mina: Happy to translate short prompts into FR and ES.

Samir: I'll do JP.

Alejandra: amazing — saving us! final note: please don't put recipient home addresses into the sheet; use the dropdown options only. will share final link later today.

Dylan: cool. count me in for May 9 assembly shift.

Alejandra: Last message — filing thread notes into the Culture project board after we confirm vendors. Thanks everyone!
